definitions.explanation: A comprehensive collection of all or most works by a single author, artist, or on a single subject, typically published as a multi-volume set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧{全集|ぜんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I am reading the complete works of Natsume Soseki.

examples.japanese: {全集|ぜんしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧20{巻|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The collected works are composed of 20 volumes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書斎|しょさい}→書斎：03760_shosai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界文学全集|せかいぶんがくぜんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずらり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: In my grandfather's study, a complete collection of world literature was lined up on the shelves.

notes:
A comprehensive collection of all or most works by a single author, typically published as a multi-volume set. Commonly used in the titles of literary and academic publications.

FORMS:
⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (complete, all) + {集|しゅう} (collection).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧{全集|ぜんしゅう}: complete written works
- {全集|ぜんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刊行|かんこう}→刊行：02788_kankou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to publish a complete works
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧○{巻|かん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全集|ぜんしゅう}: a complete works in ○ volumes
- {世界文学全集|せかいぶんがくぜんしゅう}: complete collection of world literature

COUNTER:
Volumes in a {全集|ぜんしゅう} are counted with {巻|かん}: ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧20{巻|かん} (20 volumes total).

RELATED WORDS:
- {選集|せんしゅう}: selected works (not comprehensive)
- ⟦{文庫|ぶんこ}→文庫：18437_bunko⟧: paperback series
